dashboard.title: Dashboard
projects.heading: Projects
language.label: Language
refused.unauthenticated.title: Sign-in required
refused.unauthenticated.body: Dockyard can only be reached through its authentication proxy. Open it from the address your Administrator gave you.
refused.not_invited.title: Not invited
refused.not_invited.body: The email {email} has been verified by the authentication proxy, but it has not been invited to this Dockyard Instance. Ask an Administrator to invite you.
refused.identity_unavailable.title: Identity cannot be verified
refused.identity_unavailable.body: Dockyard cannot verify who you are right now, because it cannot reach the authentication proxy. Try again in a few minutes; if it keeps happening, tell your Administrator.
not_found.title: Page not found
claude_account.heading: Claude Account
claude_account.explain: Your Projects work with your claude.ai subscription (Pro, Max, Team or Enterprise). Connect it once: Dockyard opens a terminal where you sign in.
claude_account.warning: Sign in with your claude.ai subscription only. Do not use an API key or a long-lived token (such as one made with claude setup-token): they disable Remote Control, and your Projects would not appear in the Claude app.
sign_in.title: Connect your Claude Account
sign_in.step_open: Open the link shown in the terminal and sign in with your claude.ai account.
sign_in.step_copy: Copy the code claude.ai shows you at the end.
sign_in.step_paste: Paste it below and send it, or type it in the terminal and press Enter.
sign_in.not_connected: The sign-in ended without connecting your Claude Account. Check the messages in the terminal, then try again from the dashboard.
sign_in.lost: The connection to the terminal was lost. Reload the page to see it again: the sign-in keeps waiting for you.
refused.cross_site.title: Refused: sent by another site
refused.cross_site.body: This request reached Dockyard from another site, so it was refused: only pages of Dockyard itself can act on your behalf. If you were using Dockyard at its usual address, tell your Administrator: the proxy in front of Dockyard must pass the original Host header through.
runtime_unavailable.title: Docker is unreachable
runtime_unavailable.body: Dockyard cannot reach Docker right now, so it can neither check your Claude Account nor run your Projects. Try again in a few minutes; if it keeps happening, tell your Administrator: the details are in Dockyard's log.
project_refused.repository_invalid.body: This is not the address of a repository. Use https://github.com/owner/repository or https://gitlab.com/group/project, as your browser shows it on the repository's page.
project_refused.repository_not_https.bod: Use the repository's https:// address, for example https://github.com/owner/repository. Other kinds of address, such as http:// or git@, are not accepted.
project_refused.repository_credentials.b: Remove the user name and password (or token) from the address: Dockyard never takes credentials in a URL.
project_refused.repository_port.body: Remove the port from the address: only the standard https port is accepted.
project_refused.repository_query.body: Remove everything from the ? onwards: the address of a repository has no query.
project_refused.repository_fragment.body: Remove everything from the # onwards: the address of a repository has no fragment.
project_refused.repository_host.body: Only repositories on github.com and gitlab.com are supported.
project_refused.name_missing.body: Give the Project a name: it becomes the name of its Remote Control Server in the Claude app.
project_refused.name_invalid.body: Use a name of at most 60 characters, on one line.
project_new.title: New Project
project_new.repository_hint: The https:// address of a repository on github.com or gitlab.com, for example https://github.com/owner/repository.
project_new.name: Name
project_new.name_hint: It becomes the name of its Remote Control Server in the Claude app, so you recognise it on your phone.
project_new.public_hint: Anyone can clone a public repository, so Dockyard needs no Git Credential for it.
project.cloning: Dockyard is cloning the repository; this page follows its progress.
project.error: Dockyard cannot find this Project's code. Delete the Project and create it again.
project.delete.heading: Delete this Project
project.delete.explain: Deleting removes the Project and its environment. Its code is kept unless you choose to delete it too.
project.delete.code: Also delete its code: it cannot be recovered
clone_failed.title: The clone failed
clone_failed.explain: Git could not clone {repository}. Nothing was kept: the Project has been removed, so you can simply try again.
